experiment_plans.feasibility_notes: Small synthetic series, closed-form estimators, no external dependencies needed.
experiment_plans.objective: Test whether seasonal differencing improves one-step forecast error on a series with known seasonality.
experiment_plans.design: Rolling-origin evaluation over the final quarter of the series.

data_requirements.description: A univariate series with linear trend, a fixed seasonal period, and Gaussian noise.
preprocessing_steps: Generate the series with a fixed seed
Reserve the final 25% for rolling evaluation

methods.name: seasonal differencing
methods.description: Subtract the value one seasonal period earlier before fitting.

evaluation.baseline: Persistence forecast on the undifferenced series.
evaluation.success_criteria: Seasonal differencing reduces one-step MAE by at least 10% against persistence.

risks: A misspecified seasonal period would make differencing actively harmful.

priority_order.justification: the only plan in this benchmark case
